**Job Summary**
Designs, builds and improves the user and builder experience of Equinix’s AI products and platforms, including conversational AI, agents and agent-building tools. Combines interaction design with engineering: prototypes working interfaces and conversation flows, tests them with real users and builders, and ships the results into production. Makes AI behavior understandable and controllable: clear responses, visible sources, graceful failure, human escalation and easy feedback. Measures experience quality with data and converts findings into product and engineering changes. Works in a team with senior engineers, designers and product managers, and with platform, security and business partners.
  
  
Knowledge and Application
  
  
Applies solid knowledge of human-AI interaction principles, conversation design and front-end engineering, plus working knowledge of LLM and agent concepts (prompting, retrieval, tool calling, orchestration). Understands usability research methods, accessibility standards (WCAG) and experience metrics. Understands what builders need from agent and platform tooling: clear APIs, documentation, debugging and observability. Follows established design and engineering standards and suggests improvements.
  
  
Complexity and Problem Solving
  
  
Works on problems of defined scope where analysis requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Diagnoses why users or builders struggle (unclear responses, wrong expectations, missing controls, poor tooling) using usage data, session traces and feedback, and applies existing patterns to fix it. Judges whether a metric reflects real experience quality. Escalates unusual or high-impact issues. Work is reviewed at defined checkpoints.
  
  
Collaboration and Interaction
  
  
Works with AI engineers, product managers, designers, researchers, platform and security teams. Explains usability findings and design tradeoffs to partners who are not familiar with the subject. Gathers input from end users and builders, and shares knowledge with the team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Experience engineering
  
  

* Build interactive prototypes and production interface components for AI products: chat and voice flows, agent workspaces, builder consoles and admin tools
* Design and implement conversation flows and response patterns: tone, structure, clarifying questions, source citations, confidence cues, error handling, and handoff to a person
* Implement controls that keep users in charge: review and edit before action, confirmation for high-impact steps, undo, and clear scope of what the AI can do
* Capture feedback inside the product (ratings, edits, dismissals) and route it to the teams that act on it
* Contribute to a shared component library and design system for AI interfaces
* Write unit and end-to-end tests for interface components

Builder and developer experience
  
  

* Improve the experience of people who build on the platform: onboarding, documentation, templates, SDKs, and tools for testing and debugging agents
* Reduce time to first working agent, and track where builders get stuck

Research and measurement
  
  

* Plan and run usability tests, interviews and session reviews with users and builders
* Define and track experience metrics: task completion, time to complete, adoption, retention, escalation rate, satisfaction, and builder time to first use
* Work with evaluation engineers to add experience criteria (clarity, helpfulness, appropriate tone) to evaluation rubrics and acceptance tests
* Turn findings into prioritized recommendations and backlog items

Quality and responsible practice
  
  

* Apply accessibility, localization and inclusive design requirements
* Work with InfoSec and Legal on disclosure, consent, data-handling notices and AI-generated-content labeling
* Check that interface behavior matches model and policy behavior (what the AI says it can do, versus what it can do)

* 1-4 years in front-end, full-stack, design engineering, UX engineering or AI/ML engineering
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, human-computer interaction, design, engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience
* Proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript and a modern front-end framework (e.g., React), and working Python for prototyping with models and APIs
* Portfolio or work samples showing shipped or prototyped interfaces, including at least one that uses LLMs or conversational interaction
* Working knowledge of LLM applications (prompting, retrieval, agents) and of how model behavior affects the user experience
* Familiarity with usability testing methods and accessibility standards
* Ability to read usage data and write basic SQL
* Clear written and verbal communication, including with non-technical partners

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience designing for conversational AI, voice interfaces or agent-builder tools
* Experience with design tools (e.g., Figma) and design systems
* Experience with product analytics, A/B testing or session-replay tools
* Experience with LLM evaluation or observability tools
* Experience building developer tools, SDKs or documentation
* Familiarity with responsible-AI guidelines for human-AI interaction
* MS in a related field

What success looks like
  
  

* Users complete target tasks with AI products faster and with fewer escalations, tracked on a shared metric set
* Builders get a first working agent faster, with fewer support requests
* Every AI product has defined experience criteria that are tested before release
* User feedback reaches the backlog and becomes shipped changes
* The engineer takes on larger, less defined work each quarter with decreasing guidance

**Standard Job Description**
Join our team as a Senior AI Engineer focused on ontologies, knowledge graphs, and production AI systems.
  
  
You will turn complex enterprise data into trusted knowledge that AI applications can understand and use. You will work directly with users, domain experts, data owners, and platform teams.
  
  
This role uses a forward-deployed engineering model. You will identify user problems, build solutions, deploy them, and improve them through direct feedback.
  
  
You will own work from early discovery through production support. You must be comfortable with unclear requirements, unfamiliar data, and complex system constraints.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include**

* Work with users and domain experts to define problems, outcomes, and technical requirements.
* Convert enterprise concepts and source metadata into clear ontologies and semantic models.
* Design knowledge graphs that connect business meaning to source data.
* Build AI agent workflows that create, evaluate, and improve ontology artifacts.
* Develop evaluation methods for AI quality, source traceability, query accuracy, and human review.
* Integrate relational databases, APIs, files, cloud platforms, and enterprise data systems.
* Build production software across services, APIs, background jobs, web applications, and graph query systems.
* Create tests and controls for AI output, ontology quality, data mappings, and production behavior.
* Deploy software through automated pipelines, containers, and cloud platforms.
* Observe production systems and resolve failures across application, AI, data, and infrastructure components.
* Make clear tradeoffs among user value, technical quality, security, schedule, and long-term support.
* Present technical decisions to engineering teams, domain experts, and business leaders.
* Review designs and code, mentor other engineers, and improve team engineering practices.
* Apply lessons from each user engagement to reusable platform capabilities.

This position is for a senior individual contributor. The engineer will lead technical work without requiring formal personnel authority.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related STEM field, with five years of relevant experience.
* A master’s degree with three years of relevant experience can satisfy the education and experience requirement.
* Experience developing production software in Python, including services, APIs, data pipelines, or distributed applications.
* Experience building and deploying AI, machine learning, LLM, or agent-based systems beyond an initial prototype.
* Experience designing ontologies or knowledge graphs with RDF, OWL, and SPARQL.
* Experience working directly with users or domain experts to convert unclear needs into deployed software.

**Desired Skills**

* Experience with SHACL, R2RML, ontology reasoning, ontology governance, or competency-question evaluation.
* Experience with graph databases or virtual knowledge graph platforms, such as Amazon Neptune or Ontop.
* Experience with AI agent frameworks and model platforms, such as Strands Agents, AWS Bedrock, or Azure OpenAI.
* Experience evaluating LLM systems for accuracy, traceability, safety, reliability, cost, and latency.
* Experience with Django, REST APIs, asynchronous Python, Celery, PostgreSQL, or Redis.
* Experience with React, TypeScript, or full-stack application development.
* Experience connecting SQL databases, REST APIs, OpenAPI specifications, files, or Databricks.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with production observability, structured logs, metrics, tracing, and incident resolution.
* Experience applying security and access controls to enterprise AI or data systems.
* Experience with ontology editors, semantic modeling tools, or graph visualization tools.
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical work across multiple teams.
* Experience delivering software in a customer environment with changing requirements and limited information.

Great nursing careers start with great training. Nurses at Banner Health enjoy some of the best on-the-job training in the industry. We care about you, your nursing career today and your future. Apply today and build your career.
  
  
Since 2018, the New Graduate RN Residency Program at Banner Health has been accredited by the American Nurses Credentialing Center (ANCC) as a Practice Transition Accreditation Program® (PTAP). Banner Health’s New Nurse Experience (NNE) provides a collaborative learning environment where you can refine your nursing skills, enhance your knowledge, and transition from a new graduate to a fully competent, professional nurse at Banner Health.
  
  
About our program:
  
  
The Banner Health New Nurse Experience is a full-time Registered Nurse position that assists you in transitioning from a new graduate to a fully competent, professional nurse at Banner Health. This program provides a collaborative learning environment in which you can refine your nursing skills, enhance your knowledge, and develop new personal and professional relationships.
  
  
Successful candidates will be placed in specific units at Banner Health facilities to be clinically mentored by unit staff and educators. We offer all of our New Grads multiple Career Pathways and development opportunities to achieve your long-term career goals. Whether you are wanting to go into a specialty unit, leadership roles, non-bedside nursing opportunities, or any other sector of nursing - we will help you get there! The expectation is that you will stay on your NNE unit for at least 12 months to get a full and comprehensive training experience! New Grads will also need to live within a reasonable commute distance of the facility they are hired into.
  
  
Most new nurses will work three 12 hour shifts, which will include weekend and holiday rotations with other staff members.
  
  
Program Activities Include:
  
  

* Clinical experiences with a preceptor
* Training in our state-of-the-art Banner Simulation Center
* Competency and skills assessment and verification
* Orientation to the Cerner electronic medical health record system
* Patient care skills lab that provides hands-on experience with equipment
* e-Learning modules
* Resources for professional and personal development

* Recent or Upcoming graduation from an accredited nursing program
* BSN is preferred - open to ADN at select locations

**Position Summary**
This position assesses, plans, implements, evaluates and documents nursing care of patients in accordance with organizational policies and in accordance with standards of professional nursing practice utilizing the framework for professional nursing practice and development. This position is accountable for the quality of nursing services delivered by self or others who are under their direction. This position utilizes specialized knowledge, judgment, and nursing skills necessary to assess data and plan, provide and evaluate care appropriate to the physical and developmental age of assigned patients.
  
  
**Core Functions**

* Assesses patient physical, psychological, social, spiritual, educational, developmental, cultural and discharge planning needs. Reviews patient history and physical with patient/family and assures completion within appropriate timeframe. Reviews available information obtained by other health care team members. Reviews diagnostics and laboratory data and reports abnormal results to the physician(s) and other appropriate caregivers. Completes assessment and reassessments according to patient need and as outlined in policy.
* Formulates a plan of care, including the discharge plan, utilizing assessment data and patient, family and health team input. Initiates a plan of care based on patient-specific needs, assessment data and the medical plan of care. Goals for patient are realistic, measurable and developed in conjunction with the patient/family. Considers the physical, cultural, psychosocial, spiritual, age specific and educational needs of the patient in the plan of are. Plans care in collaboration with members of the multidisciplinary team. Reviews and revises the plan of care to reflect changing patient needs based on evaluation of the patient’s status.
* Implements the plan of care through direct patient care, coordination, delegation and supervision of the activities of the health care team. Provides care based on physician orders and the nursing plan of care, in compliance with policies and procedures, standards of care, and regulatory agency requirements. Delegates appropriately, and provides nursing supervision in the provision of care to patients by other licensed nurses and other personnel. Promotes continuity of care by accurately and completely communicating to other caregivers the status of patients for whom care is provided.
* Evaluates the patient's and family's response to care and teaching, and revises the plan of care as needed. Evaluates patient progress towards goals and expected outcomes in collaboration with other health care team members. Evaluates patient's response and the effectiveness of patient teaching.
* Documents assessment, planning, implementation and evaluation in the patient record. Documentation is legible, timely and in accordance with policy. Documentation reflects objective/subjective data, nursing interventions and patient's response to treatment. Notes physician orders accurately and in a timely manner.
* Provides care based on the best evidence available and may participate in research activities within clinical practice. Participates in unit or facility shared leadership. Interacts and participates in the education, role development, and orientation of facility personnel, patients, students, families and visitors. Promotes/supports growth of others through precepting and mentoring when appropriate.
* Contributes to society through activities that lead to excellent patient outcomes through timely, effective, efficient, equitable, and safe care. Actively participates in the improvement of national nursing quality indicators and outcomes. Such activities may include participating in professional organizations.
* In some roles, this position may supervise staff and work flow of the department.
* Interacts with all levels of staff in a variety of departments, physicians, patients, families and external contacts, such as employees of other health care institutions, community providers and agencies, concerning the health care of the patient. Interacts with other health care providers in numerous settings in order to report and ask for or clarify information. Also works with clergy to provide spiritual support. Synthesizes and prioritizes data from multiple sources to provide support for the human response of the patient and family to changes in health status.

**Standard Job Description**
Join our team as a Senior AI Engineer focused on ontologies, knowledge graphs, and production AI systems.
  
  
You will turn complex enterprise data into trusted knowledge that AI applications can understand and use. You will work directly with users, domain experts, data owners, and platform teams.
  
  
This role uses a forward-deployed engineering model. You will identify user problems, build solutions, deploy them, and improve them through direct feedback.
  
  
You will own work from early discovery through production support. You must be comfortable with unclear requirements, unfamiliar data, and complex system constraints.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include**

* Work with users and domain experts to define problems, outcomes, and technical requirements.
* Convert enterprise concepts and source metadata into clear ontologies and semantic models.
* Design knowledge graphs that connect business meaning to source data.
* Build AI agent workflows that create, evaluate, and improve ontology artifacts.
* Develop evaluation methods for AI quality, source traceability, query accuracy, and human review.
* Integrate relational databases, APIs, files, cloud platforms, and enterprise data systems.
* Build production software across services, APIs, background jobs, web applications, and graph query systems.
* Create tests and controls for AI output, ontology quality, data mappings, and production behavior.
* Deploy software through automated pipelines, containers, and cloud platforms.
* Observe production systems and resolve failures across application, AI, data, and infrastructure components.
* Make clear tradeoffs among user value, technical quality, security, schedule, and long-term support.
* Present technical decisions to engineering teams, domain experts, and business leaders.
* Review designs and code, mentor other engineers, and improve team engineering practices.
* Apply lessons from each user engagement to reusable platform capabilities.

This position is for a senior individual contributor. The engineer will lead technical work without requiring formal personnel authority.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related STEM field, with five years of relevant experience.
* A master’s degree with three years of relevant experience can satisfy the education and experience requirement.
* Experience developing production software in Python, including services, APIs, data pipelines, or distributed applications.
* Experience building and deploying AI, machine learning, LLM, or agent-based systems beyond an initial prototype.
* Experience designing ontologies or knowledge graphs with RDF, OWL, and SPARQL.
* Experience working directly with users or domain experts to convert unclear needs into deployed software.

**Desired Skills**

* Experience with SHACL, R2RML, ontology reasoning, ontology governance, or competency-question evaluation.
* Experience with graph databases or virtual knowledge graph platforms, such as Amazon Neptune or Ontop.
* Experience with AI agent frameworks and model platforms, such as Strands Agents, AWS Bedrock, or Azure OpenAI.
* Experience evaluating LLM systems for accuracy, traceability, safety, reliability, cost, and latency.
* Experience with Django, REST APIs, asynchronous Python, Celery, PostgreSQL, or Redis.
* Experience with React, TypeScript, or full-stack application development.
* Experience connecting SQL databases, REST APIs, OpenAPI specifications, files, or Databricks.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with production observability, structured logs, metrics, tracing, and incident resolution.
* Experience applying security and access controls to enterprise AI or data systems.
* Experience with ontology editors, semantic modeling tools, or graph visualization tools.
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical work across multiple teams.
* Experience delivering software in a customer environment with changing requirements and limited information.

**Standard Job Description**
Join our team as a Senior AI Engineer focused on ontologies, knowledge graphs, and production AI systems.
  
  
You will turn complex enterprise data into trusted knowledge that AI applications can understand and use. You will work directly with users, domain experts, data owners, and platform teams.
  
  
This role uses a forward-deployed engineering model. You will identify user problems, build solutions, deploy them, and improve them through direct feedback.
  
  
You will own work from early discovery through production support. You must be comfortable with unclear requirements, unfamiliar data, and complex system constraints.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include**

* Work with users and domain experts to define problems, outcomes, and technical requirements.
* Convert enterprise concepts and source metadata into clear ontologies and semantic models.
* Design knowledge graphs that connect business meaning to source data.
* Build AI agent workflows that create, evaluate, and improve ontology artifacts.
* Develop evaluation methods for AI quality, source traceability, query accuracy, and human review.
* Integrate relational databases, APIs, files, cloud platforms, and enterprise data systems.
* Build production software across services, APIs, background jobs, web applications, and graph query systems.
* Create tests and controls for AI output, ontology quality, data mappings, and production behavior.
* Deploy software through automated pipelines, containers, and cloud platforms.
* Observe production systems and resolve failures across application, AI, data, and infrastructure components.
* Make clear tradeoffs among user value, technical quality, security, schedule, and long-term support.
* Present technical decisions to engineering teams, domain experts, and business leaders.
* Review designs and code, mentor other engineers, and improve team engineering practices.
* Apply lessons from each user engagement to reusable platform capabilities.

This position is for a senior individual contributor. The engineer will lead technical work without requiring formal personnel authority.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related STEM field, with five years of relevant experience.
* A master’s degree with three years of relevant experience can satisfy the education and experience requirement.
* Experience developing production software in Python, including services, APIs, data pipelines, or distributed applications.
* Experience building and deploying AI, machine learning, LLM, or agent-based systems beyond an initial prototype.
* Experience designing ontologies or knowledge graphs with RDF, OWL, and SPARQL.
* Experience working directly with users or domain experts to convert unclear needs into deployed software.

**Desired Skills**

* Experience with SHACL, R2RML, ontology reasoning, ontology governance, or competency-question evaluation.
* Experience with graph databases or virtual knowledge graph platforms, such as Amazon Neptune or Ontop.
* Experience with AI agent frameworks and model platforms, such as Strands Agents, AWS Bedrock, or Azure OpenAI.
* Experience evaluating LLM systems for accuracy, traceability, safety, reliability, cost, and latency.
* Experience with Django, REST APIs, asynchronous Python, Celery, PostgreSQL, or Redis.
* Experience with React, TypeScript, or full-stack application development.
* Experience connecting SQL databases, REST APIs, OpenAPI specifications, files, or Databricks.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with production observability, structured logs, metrics, tracing, and incident resolution.
* Experience applying security and access controls to enterprise AI or data systems.
* Experience with ontology editors, semantic modeling tools, or graph visualization tools.
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical work across multiple teams.
* Experience delivering software in a customer environment with changing requirements and limited information.

**Standard Job Description**
Join our team as a Senior AI Engineer focused on ontologies, knowledge graphs, and production AI systems.
  
  
You will turn complex enterprise data into trusted knowledge that AI applications can understand and use. You will work directly with users, domain experts, data owners, and platform teams.
  
  
This role uses a forward-deployed engineering model. You will identify user problems, build solutions, deploy them, and improve them through direct feedback.
  
  
You will own work from early discovery through production support. You must be comfortable with unclear requirements, unfamiliar data, and complex system constraints.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include**

* Work with users and domain experts to define problems, outcomes, and technical requirements.
* Convert enterprise concepts and source metadata into clear ontologies and semantic models.
* Design knowledge graphs that connect business meaning to source data.
* Build AI agent workflows that create, evaluate, and improve ontology artifacts.
* Develop evaluation methods for AI quality, source traceability, query accuracy, and human review.
* Integrate relational databases, APIs, files, cloud platforms, and enterprise data systems.
* Build production software across services, APIs, background jobs, web applications, and graph query systems.
* Create tests and controls for AI output, ontology quality, data mappings, and production behavior.
* Deploy software through automated pipelines, containers, and cloud platforms.
* Observe production systems and resolve failures across application, AI, data, and infrastructure components.
* Make clear tradeoffs among user value, technical quality, security, schedule, and long-term support.
* Present technical decisions to engineering teams, domain experts, and business leaders.
* Review designs and code, mentor other engineers, and improve team engineering practices.
* Apply lessons from each user engagement to reusable platform capabilities.

This position is for a senior individual contributor. The engineer will lead technical work without requiring formal personnel authority.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related STEM field, with five years of relevant experience.
* A master’s degree with three years of relevant experience can satisfy the education and experience requirement.
* Experience developing production software in Python, including services, APIs, data pipelines, or distributed applications.
* Experience building and deploying AI, machine learning, LLM, or agent-based systems beyond an initial prototype.
* Experience designing ontologies or knowledge graphs with RDF, OWL, and SPARQL.
* Experience working directly with users or domain experts to convert unclear needs into deployed software.

**Desired Skills**

* Experience with SHACL, R2RML, ontology reasoning, ontology governance, or competency-question evaluation.
* Experience with graph databases or virtual knowledge graph platforms, such as Amazon Neptune or Ontop.
* Experience with AI agent frameworks and model platforms, such as Strands Agents, AWS Bedrock, or Azure OpenAI.
* Experience evaluating LLM systems for accuracy, traceability, safety, reliability, cost, and latency.
* Experience with Django, REST APIs, asynchronous Python, Celery, PostgreSQL, or Redis.
* Experience with React, TypeScript, or full-stack application development.
* Experience connecting SQL databases, REST APIs, OpenAPI specifications, files, or Databricks.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with production observability, structured logs, metrics, tracing, and incident resolution.
* Experience applying security and access controls to enterprise AI or data systems.
* Experience with ontology editors, semantic modeling tools, or graph visualization tools.
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical work across multiple teams.
* Experience delivering software in a customer environment with changing requirements and limited information.

**Standard Job Description**
Join our team as a Senior AI Engineer focused on ontologies, knowledge graphs, and production AI systems.
  
  
You will turn complex enterprise data into trusted knowledge that AI applications can understand and use. You will work directly with users, domain experts, data owners, and platform teams.
  
  
This role uses a forward-deployed engineering model. You will identify user problems, build solutions, deploy them, and improve them through direct feedback.
  
  
You will own work from early discovery through production support. You must be comfortable with unclear requirements, unfamiliar data, and complex system constraints.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include**

* Work with users and domain experts to define problems, outcomes, and technical requirements.
* Convert enterprise concepts and source metadata into clear ontologies and semantic models.
* Design knowledge graphs that connect business meaning to source data.
* Build AI agent workflows that create, evaluate, and improve ontology artifacts.
* Develop evaluation methods for AI quality, source traceability, query accuracy, and human review.
* Integrate relational databases, APIs, files, cloud platforms, and enterprise data systems.
* Build production software across services, APIs, background jobs, web applications, and graph query systems.
* Create tests and controls for AI output, ontology quality, data mappings, and production behavior.
* Deploy software through automated pipelines, containers, and cloud platforms.
* Observe production systems and resolve failures across application, AI, data, and infrastructure components.
* Make clear tradeoffs among user value, technical quality, security, schedule, and long-term support.
* Present technical decisions to engineering teams, domain experts, and business leaders.
* Review designs and code, mentor other engineers, and improve team engineering practices.
* Apply lessons from each user engagement to reusable platform capabilities.

This position is for a senior individual contributor. The engineer will lead technical work without requiring formal personnel authority.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related STEM field, with five years of relevant experience.
* A master’s degree with three years of relevant experience can satisfy the education and experience requirement.
* Experience developing production software in Python, including services, APIs, data pipelines, or distributed applications.
* Experience building and deploying AI, machine learning, LLM, or agent-based systems beyond an initial prototype.
* Experience designing ontologies or knowledge graphs with RDF, OWL, and SPARQL.
* Experience working directly with users or domain experts to convert unclear needs into deployed software.

**Desired Skills**

* Experience with SHACL, R2RML, ontology reasoning, ontology governance, or competency-question evaluation.
* Experience with graph databases or virtual knowledge graph platforms, such as Amazon Neptune or Ontop.
* Experience with AI agent frameworks and model platforms, such as Strands Agents, AWS Bedrock, or Azure OpenAI.
* Experience evaluating LLM systems for accuracy, traceability, safety, reliability, cost, and latency.
* Experience with Django, REST APIs, asynchronous Python, Celery, PostgreSQL, or Redis.
* Experience with React, TypeScript, or full-stack application development.
* Experience connecting SQL databases, REST APIs, OpenAPI specifications, files, or Databricks.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with production observability, structured logs, metrics, tracing, and incident resolution.
* Experience applying security and access controls to enterprise AI or data systems.
* Experience with ontology editors, semantic modeling tools, or graph visualization tools.
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical work across multiple teams.
* Experience delivering software in a customer environment with changing requirements and limited information.

* Convert engagement-specific solutions into reusable platform capabilities.
* Review architecture and code for quality, security, supportability, and system fit.
* Mentor engineers and establish consistent engineering practices across teams.
* Present technical decisions, risks, and results to technical and business leaders.
* Influence technical direction across teams without formal authority.

* A bachelor’s degree in a related STEM field and nine years of relevant experience.

* Experience with graph databases or virtual knowledge graph systems.

* Experience with AI agent frameworks and enterprise model platforms.
* Experience with AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or comparable model services.
* Experience evaluating LLM systems for accuracy, traceability, reliability, security, cost, and latency.
* Experience designing human review and approval controls for AI-generated artifacts.
* Experience with Django, asynchronous Python, Celery, PostgreSQL, Redis, or comparable technologies.
* Experience with React, TypeScript, or full-stack application development.
* Experience integrating SQL databases, REST APIs, OpenAPI specifications, files, or Databricks.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with production observability, incident response, and root-cause analysis.
* Experience applying security and access controls to enterprise AI or data systems.
* Experience leading architecture reviews or technical standards across engineering teams.
* Experience mentoring senior engineers and improving team engineering practices.
* Experience delivering software in customer environments with unclear or changing requirements.
* Experience converting customer-specific solutions into reusable products or platform services.

**Standard Job Description**
Responsible for developing, integrating, and deploying autonomy and artificial intelligence algorithms for mission systems, supporting the technology development life cycle from requirements generation through development, integration, and testing, as well as research in some organizations.Develops, integrates, and implements algorithms to enable perception, motion/mission planning, controls, etc. functionality in LM products and platforms; Translates requirements and applies requirements to development code, integrating autonomy, AI or machine learning algorithms to LM products and platforms; Determines software methods to best acquire and execute knowledge; Implements algorithms into software to train systems to recognize patterns and perform specific functions; Responsible for various phases of developing and maintaining autonomy software from requirements generation, software design and development to integration, testing, troubleshooting and debugging, and implementation; Review test outcomes, conducts troubleshooting, and works to debug issues; Develops human-machine interface scenarios, breaking missions into tasks; Documents interface requirements and implements human-machine interfaces
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field or equivalent professional experience.
* Experience with Python and AI Frameworks
* Project Management experience with software development
* Excellent written and verbal skills

**Desired Skills**
Experience designing, developing, testing and deploying agentic automations
  
  
RPA Platforms
  
  

* Proven experience with Blue Prism or an equivalent RPA tool such as UiPath (designing, debugging, and deploying bots in a production environment).

Python Automation Stack
  
  

* Proficiency with agentic frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, and ability to orchestrate LLM‑driven workflows.

Hands‑on with open‑source RPA libraries
  
  

* Playwright (web automation) and pywinauto (desktop UI automation).
* Hands-on experience with graph database libraries: Neo4J, Ontop, OrientDB, or similar.
* OpenCode / Clinerule Automation – Ability to leverage OpenCode (or Clinerule) to rapidly prototype and build agentic automations, including writing custom skills, prompt engineering, and integrating LLM outputs into process flows.

Version Control & CI/CD
  
  

* Strong Git workflow experience (branching, pull‑requests, code reviews) and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment of automation assets.

Business Process Expertise
  
  

* Skilled at process mapping (e.g., BPMN, flowcharts), analyzing end‑to‑end workflows, and translating business requirements into repeatable, scalable automation solutions.

Communication & Relationship Building
  
  

* Excellent written and verbal communication; capable of documenting technical solutions clearly and building rapport with business stakeholders and customers to gather requirements and drive adoption.

Project Management
  
  

* Experience managing automation projects end‑to‑end: scoping, estimating effort, tracking milestones, risk mitigation, and delivering on schedule.

Ontology Engineering
  
  

* Experience with ontology design, development, and management using tools like Protege for ontology modeling and Ontop for ontology-based data access (OBDA), enabling semantic data integration and reasoning over complex data sources.

**Standard Job Description**
Join our team as a Senior AI Engineer focused on ontologies, knowledge graphs, and production AI systems.
  
  
You will turn complex enterprise data into trusted knowledge that AI applications can understand and use. You will work directly with users, domain experts, data owners, and platform teams.
  
  
This role uses a forward-deployed engineering model. You will identify user problems, build solutions, deploy them, and improve them through direct feedback.
  
  
You will own work from early discovery through production support. You must be comfortable with unclear requirements, unfamiliar data, and complex system constraints.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include**

* Work with users and domain experts to define problems, outcomes, and technical requirements.
* Convert enterprise concepts and source metadata into clear ontologies and semantic models.
* Design knowledge graphs that connect business meaning to source data.
* Build AI agent workflows that create, evaluate, and improve ontology artifacts.
* Develop evaluation methods for AI quality, source traceability, query accuracy, and human review.
* Integrate relational databases, APIs, files, cloud platforms, and enterprise data systems.
* Build production software across services, APIs, background jobs, web applications, and graph query systems.
* Create tests and controls for AI output, ontology quality, data mappings, and production behavior.
* Deploy software through automated pipelines, containers, and cloud platforms.
* Observe production systems and resolve failures across application, AI, data, and infrastructure components.
* Make clear tradeoffs among user value, technical quality, security, schedule, and long-term support.
* Present technical decisions to engineering teams, domain experts, and business leaders.
* Review designs and code, mentor other engineers, and improve team engineering practices.
* Apply lessons from each user engagement to reusable platform capabilities.

This position is for a senior individual contributor. The engineer will lead technical work without requiring formal personnel authority.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related STEM field, with five years of relevant experience.
* A master’s degree with three years of relevant experience can satisfy the education and experience requirement.
* Experience developing production software in Python, including services, APIs, data pipelines, or distributed applications.
* Experience building and deploying AI, machine learning, LLM, or agent-based systems beyond an initial prototype.
* Experience designing ontologies or knowledge graphs with RDF, OWL, and SPARQL.
* Experience working directly with users or domain experts to convert unclear needs into deployed software.

**Desired Skills**

* Experience with SHACL, R2RML, ontology reasoning, ontology governance, or competency-question evaluation.
* Experience with graph databases or virtual knowledge graph platforms, such as Amazon Neptune or Ontop.
* Experience with AI agent frameworks and model platforms, such as Strands Agents, AWS Bedrock, or Azure OpenAI.
* Experience evaluating LLM systems for accuracy, traceability, safety, reliability, cost, and latency.
* Experience with Django, REST APIs, asynchronous Python, Celery, PostgreSQL, or Redis.
* Experience with React, TypeScript, or full-stack application development.
* Experience connecting SQL databases, REST APIs, OpenAPI specifications, files, or Databricks.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with production observability, structured logs, metrics, tracing, and incident resolution.
* Experience applying security and access controls to enterprise AI or data systems.
* Experience with ontology editors, semantic modeling tools, or graph visualization tools.
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical work across multiple teams.
* Experience delivering software in a customer environment with changing requirements and limited information.

**WHAT WE'RE DOING**
Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems is looking for Software professionals to work on Cross-Domain Solution (CDS) products that protect and defend the information flow of critical and time sensitive data on many military application and networks.
  
  
**Who We Are**
At Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems (RMS), you will ensure cyber security standards are met and implemented.
  
  
**Who You Are**
The candidate will be working in an agile development environment on RedHat Linux-based OS, and will be responsible for supporting elements of the design/sustainment/development efforts. The candidate should be a well-rounded software developer with experience in an object oriented language, such as C++, C# and Java. The candidate should be a self-starter that is attentive to details and works well in a team.
  
  
**THE WORK**
Duties to include software design and development in a Java/C++/C# SELinux environment, SELinux Policy creation, maintenance and debugging, message parser development, XML schema development, network protocol integration, shell scripting development, and software test.
  
  
Additionally, the proven ability to provide software engineering is required. Flexibility and agility to changing requirements and programming languages, and a desire to learn and experience new opportunities to improve team performance is a must.
  
  
Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.
  
  
Join the team to help become “Raise the Bar” compliant. This compliance will involve the implementation of new stream and file pipelines for many different protocols including video.
  
  
This team promotes the Agile Methodologies, where it has 4 3-month increments per year. Each increment has 4 3-week sprints. A typical sprint will include planning, retrospectives, demos to stakeholders, development and test stories, and finally selloffs to track progress to a product owner. Each team will consist of a Scrum Master and 4-7 developers and testers. The development teams works within the Deer Creek facility and at times can work remote.
  
  
In addition as a developer for TMAN if you will have opportunities to volunteer support to the end customers by travelling to site and performing installations or trainings of the cross domain solution.
  
  
The individual selected for this team will need to have a high level of self and team motivation. An ideal candidate will be a self-starter and a strong problem solver. They will also need to have a deep understanding of continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD).
  
  
Many digital transformation techniques are used to facilitate development on the problem include Jenkins, Atlassian Suite of Tools, automated testing through software integration tests (SWIT), CPPUnit, JUnits with JMockit, and Eggplant.
  
  
This position will involve software development using Java / C++/C# and some bsh/python 80% of the time with a team that collaborates between each other hourly. SELInux policies are also important to TMAN as we are required to run our software with SELinux enabled. The Cross domain solution also requires strong linux and networking knowledge.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* DoD Interim Secret Security Clearance
* Working knowledge of C++, C# or Java
* Some knowledge of network programming, TCP, UDP, IPC
* Object-Oriented development
* Unit Testing – GTest, Junit, Jmockit

**Desired Skills**

* Python, Perl, Bash
* Linux
* SELinux
* Security+
* Cross Domain Solutions
* Raise the Bar
* CI/CD - Jenkins, Fortify, Sonarqube
* Version Control: Git/Bitbucket

**WHAT WE'RE DOING**
Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems is looking for Software professionals to work on Cross-Domain Solution (CDS) products that protect and defend the information flow of critical and time sensitive data on many military application and networks.
  
  
**Who We Are**
At Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems (RMS), you will ensure cyber security standards are met and implemented.
  
  
**Who You Are**
The candidate will be working in an agile development environment on RedHat Linux-based OS, and will be responsible for supporting elements of the design/sustainment/development efforts. The candidate should be a well-rounded software developer with experience in an object oriented language, such as C++, C# and Java. The candidate should be a self-starter that is attentive to details and works well in a team.
  
  
**THE WORK**
Duties to include software design and development in a Java/C++/C# SELinux environment, SELinux Policy creation, maintenance and debugging, message parser development, XML schema development, network protocol integration, shell scripting development, and software test.
  
  
Additionally, the proven ability to provide software engineering is required. Flexibility and agility to changing requirements and programming languages, and a desire to learn and experience new opportunities to improve team performance is a must.
  
  
Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.
  
  
Join the team to help become “Raise the Bar” compliant. This compliance will involve the implementation of new stream and file pipelines for many different protocols including video.
  
  
This team promotes the Agile Methodologies, where it has 4 3-month increments per year. Each increment has 4 3-week sprints. A typical sprint will include planning, retrospectives, demos to stakeholders, development and test stories, and finally selloffs to track progress to a product owner. Each team will consist of a Scrum Master and 4-7 developers and testers. The development teams works within the Deer Creek facility and at times can work remote.
  
  
In addition as a developer for TMAN if you will have opportunities to volunteer support to the end customers by travelling to site and performing installations or trainings of the cross domain solution.
  
  
The individual selected for this team will need to have a high level of self and team motivation. An ideal candidate will be a self-starter and a strong problem solver. They will also need to have a deep understanding of continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD).
  
  
Many digital transformation techniques are used to facilitate development on the problem include Jenkins, Atlassian Suite of Tools, automated testing through software integration tests (SWIT), CPPUnit, JUnits with JMockit, and Eggplant.
  
  
This position will involve software development using Java / C++/C# and some bsh/python 80% of the time with a team that collaborates between each other hourly. SELInux policies are also important to TMAN as we are required to run our software with SELinux enabled. The Cross domain solution also requires strong linux and networking knowledge.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* DoD Interim Secret Security Clearance
* Working knowledge of C++, C# or Java
* Some knowledge of network programming, TCP, UDP, IPC
* Object-Oriented development
* Unit Testing – GTest, Junit, Jmockit

**Desired Skills**

* Python, Perl, Bash
* Linux
* SELinux
* Security+
* Cross Domain Solutions
* Raise the Bar
* CI/CD - Jenkins, Fortify, Sonarqube
* Version Control: Git/Bitbucket

WHAT WE'RE DOING
  
  
Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems is looking for Software professionals to work on Cross-Domain Solution (CDS) products that protect and defend the information flow of critical and time sensitive data on many military application and networks.
  
  
**Who We Are**
At Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems (RMS), you will ensure cyber security standards are met and implemented.
  
  
**Who You Are**
The candidate will be working in an agile development environment on RedHat Linux-based OS, and will be responsible for supporting elements of the design/sustainment/development efforts. The candidate should be a well-rounded software developer with experience in an object oriented language, such as C++, C# and Java. The candidate should be a self-starter that is attentive to details and works well in a team.
  
  
THE WORK
  
  
Duties to include software design and development in a Java/C++/C# SELinux environment, SELinux Policy creation, maintenance and debugging, message parser development, XML schema development, network protocol integration, shell scripting development, and software test.
  
  
Additionally, the proven ability to provide software engineering is required. Flexibility and agility to changing requirements and programming languages, and a desire to learn and experience new opportunities to improve team performance is a must.
  
  
Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.
  
  
Join the team to help become “Raise the Bar” compliant. This compliance will involve the implementation of new stream and file pipelines for many different protocols including video.
  
  
This team promotes the Agile Methodologies, where it has 4 3-month increments per year. Each increment has 4 3-week sprints. A typical sprint will include planning, retrospectives, demos to stakeholders, development and test stories, and finally selloffs to track progress to a product owner. Each team will consist of a Scrum Master and 4-7 developers and testers. The development teams works within the Deer Creek facility and at times can work remote.
  
  
In addition as a developer for TMAN if you will have opportunities to volunteer support to the end customers by travelling to site and performing installations or trainings of the cross domain solution.
  
  
The individual selected for this team will need to have a high level of self and team motivation. An ideal candidate will be a self-starter and a strong problem solver. They will also need to have a deep understanding of continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD).
  
  
Many digital transformation techniques are used to facilitate development on the problem include Jenkins, Atlassian Suite of Tools, automated testing through software integration tests (SWIT), CPPUnit, JUnits with JMockit, and Eggplant.
  
  
This position will involve software development using Java / C++/C# and some bsh/python 80% of the time with a team that collaborates between each other hourly. SELInux policies are also important to TMAN as we are required to run our software with SELinux enabled. The Cross domain solution also requires strong linux and networking knowledge.

* DoD Interim Secret Security Clearance
* Working knowledge of C++, C# or Java
* Some knowledge of network programming, TCP, UDP, IPC
* Object-Oriented development
* Unit Testing – GTest, Junit, Jmockit

* Python, Perl, Bash
* Linux
* SELinux
* Security+
* Cross Domain Solutions
* Raise the Bar
* CI/CD - Jenkins, Fortify, Sonarqube

**Standard Job Description**
Plans, conducts, and coordinates software development activities. Designs, develops, documents, tests, and debugs software that contains logical and mathematical solutions to business/mission problems or questions in computer language for solutions by means of data processing equipment. Applies the appropriate standards, processes, procedures, and tools throughout the development life cycle. Applies knowledge of computer hardware and software, subject matter to be programmed in business/mission applications, information processing techniques used, and information gathered from system users to develop software. Corrects program errors, prepares operating instructions, compiles documentation of program development, and analyzes system capabilities to resolve questions of program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques, and controls. Ensures software standards are met.
  
  
We are looking for a motivated Software Engineer to join our team and support the development of our custom microservice pipeline architecture. In this role, you will use solid C++ design principles to maintain and improve a system built for high-rate data processing. You will connect this pipeline with AWS SNS and SQS for messaging, and work alongside code optimized for GPUs and CUDA.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* C++ Pipeline Development: Use clean C++ design principles to write readable, maintainable, and efficient code for our data pipelines.
* Microservice Integration: Work with pipeline design for microservices, helping data flow smoothly between different components.
* Cloud Messaging: Experience with cloud infrastructure using AWS SNS and SQS to handle decoupled messaging.
* Learn GPU Computing: Dive into a codebase that processes high-rate data using GPUs and CUDA, learning how to maintain and adapt this specialized code over time.
* Flow Monitoring: Keep the system healthy by implementing and using metrics to track data flow and identify bottlenecks.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience: 2+ years of professional software engineering experience using C++ and Python.
* C++ Foundations: Strong working knowledge of modern C++ (C++11/17) with a solid grasp of memory management, object-oriented design, and clean code principles.
* AWS Messaging: Practical experience using AWS SNS and SQS for basic queue management and pub/sub messaging patterns.
* Growth Mindset: A strong, proven motivation to learn. You are comfortable jumping into a new codebase, asking questions, and expanding your technical toolkit.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

**Desired Skills**

* GPU Exposure: Basic familiarity or academic exposure to GPU computing or CUDA code
* Pipeline Telemetry: Experience implementing flow monitoring, application logging, or performance metrics tracking.
* Advanced Python: Experience writing Python for automation scripting, data orchestration, or backend pipeline components.

WHAT WE'RE DOING
  
  
Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems is looking for Software professionals to work on Cross-Domain Solution (CDS) products that protect and defend the information flow of critical and time sensitive data on many military application and networks.
  
  
**Who We Are**
At Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems (RMS), you will ensure cyber security standards are met and implemented.
  
  
**Who You Are**
The candidate will be working in an agile development environment on RedHat Linux-based OS, and will be responsible for supporting elements of the design/sustainment/development efforts. The candidate should be a well-rounded software developer with experience in an object oriented language, such as C++, C# and Java. The candidate should be a self-starter that is attentive to details and works well in a team.
  
  
THE WORK
  
  
Duties to include software design and development in a Java/C++/C# SELinux environment, SELinux Policy creation, maintenance and debugging, message parser development, XML schema development, network protocol integration, shell scripting development, and software test.
  
  
Additionally, the proven ability to provide software engineering is required. Flexibility and agility to changing requirements and programming languages, and a desire to learn and experience new opportunities to improve team performance is a must.
  
  
Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.
  
  
Join the team to help become “Raise the Bar” compliant. This compliance will involve the implementation of new stream and file pipelines for many different protocols including video.
  
  
This team promotes the Agile Methodologies, where it has 4 3-month increments per year. Each increment has 4 3-week sprints. A typical sprint will include planning, retrospectives, demos to stakeholders, development and test stories, and finally selloffs to track progress to a product owner. Each team will consist of a Scrum Master and 4-7 developers and testers. The development teams works within the Deer Creek facility and at times can work remote.
  
  
In addition as a developer for TMAN if you will have opportunities to volunteer support to the end customers by travelling to site and performing installations or trainings of the cross domain solution.
  
  
The individual selected for this team will need to have a high level of self and team motivation. An ideal candidate will be a self-starter and a strong problem solver. They will also need to have a deep understanding of continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD).
  
  
Many digital transformation techniques are used to facilitate development on the problem include Jenkins, Atlassian Suite of Tools, automated testing through software integration tests (SWIT), CPPUnit, JUnits with JMockit, and Eggplant.
  
  
This position will involve software development using Java / C++/C# and some bsh/python 80% of the time with a team that collaborates between each other hourly. SELInux policies are also important to TMAN as we are required to run our software with SELinux enabled. The Cross domain solution also requires strong linux and networking knowledge.

* Unit Testing – GTest, Junit, Jmockit

* Python, Perl, Bash
* Linux
* SELinux
* Security+
* Cross Domain Solutions
* Raise the Bar
* CI/CD - Jenkins, Fortify, Sonarqube
* Version Control: Git/Bitbucket

**Introduction**
A career at Anderon provides the rare opportunity to help define a new industry. We’re a wafer foundry that’s commercializing semiconductor manufacturing for quantum chips. You’ll partner with innovative clients and leading researchers to develop the technology needed to build the coming quantum economy.
  
  

* Please note: Anderon uses IBM's recruitment platform for candidate applications and hiring workflows. While this role is with Anderon, all applications will be submitted and processed through IBM's careers system.

**Job Summary**
We are seeking a highly motivated
**Workflow Automation Software Developer**
to join the Anderon's Foundry Enablement Team. This role is critical to scaling Anderon’s tapeout operations as the number of technologies, testsites, and mask deliveries continues to grow.
  
  
The successful candidate will design, build, deploy, and maintain Python-based automation solutions, web applications, AI-enabled workflows, and scalable data systems supporting tapeout, testsite, mask-release, and engineering operations. The role will also contribute to developing a trusted and scalable source of truth for technology, testsite, mask, and execution data.
  
  
This position requires a self-starter who thrives in an agile, startup-style environment. The candidate must be comfortable identifying opportunities, proposing solutions, independently developing and deploying ideas, and collaborating with engineering and operations teams to deliver reliable software that solves real execution challenges.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Software Development: Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain Python-based applications and services supporting semiconductor engineering and tapeout operations.
* Workflow Automation: Identify manual, repetitive, and error-prone activities across tapeout, testsite, mask release, and engineering execution workflows, then develop automation that improves efficiency, quality, and scalability.
* Web Application Development: Build intuitive web-based tools, dashboards, and workflow applications that enable engineering teams to access data, manage execution, and monitor progress.
* AI and Intelligent Automation: Develop AI-assisted and agentic workflows supporting data collection, task orchestration, engineering decision support, document generation, and execution monitoring.
* Data and Systems Architecture: Develop and maintain scalable databases and data models for technology, testsite, reticle, mask, schedule, and execution information.
* Application Integration: Develop APIs and integrations connecting applications with databases, engineering tools, AI services, and enterprise platforms.
* End-to-End Ownership: Take software solutions from initial concept and requirements through implementation, testing, deployment, documentation, user adoption, and ongoing support.
* Agile Delivery: Work iteratively, prioritize high-value use cases, rapidly prototype ideas, incorporate user feedback, and continuously improve deployed solutions.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with semiconductor technology, design enablement, tapeout, mask release, and operations teams to translate complex engineering needs into practical software solutions.
* Software Quality: Apply version control, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, documentation, security, and maintainability practices appropriate for production software.

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a Software Developer specializing in Automation, you will design and build systems and tools that automate repetitive tasks and processes to increase efficiency and accuracy. You will develop innovative solutions that cater to business requirements, focusing on end-to-end product experiences.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Design Automation Solutions: Create automated solutions based on business requirements, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems and processes. This involves analyzing business needs, identifying areas for automation, and developing tailored solutions.
* Develop Scripts and Frameworks: Develop scripts, programs, and frameworks for automating software development, testing, and deployment. This includes writing clean, efficient code and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure effective implementation.
* Improve Automation Strategies: Continuously evaluate and improve automation strategies, identifying opportunities for growth and optimization. This involves monitoring performance metrics, gathering feedback, and implementing changes to enhance overall efficiency.
* Deliver End-to-End Solutions: Focus on delivering end-to-end product experiences, ensuring that automation solutions meet business outcomes and technical requirements. This involves collaborating with stakeholders to understand business needs and developing solutions that cater to those needs.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
**Minimum Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.
* Three or more years of professional software development or engineering automation experience.
* Three or more years of Python development experience, including the design and maintenance of reusable, production-quality software.
* Experience developing web applications, APIs, or backend services using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Experience using Git and collaborative software development practices such as branching, pull requests, code review, and release management.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* Five or more years of experience developing software applications, engineering automation platforms, workflow systems, or data-driven tools.
* Experience working in the semiconductor industry, particularly in semiconductor technology development, design enablement, testsite execution, tapeout, reticle management, or mask-release operations.
* Understanding of semiconductor development data and workflows, including technologies, process design kits, testsites, design releases, tapeouts, reticles, masks, and engineering execution milestones.
* Experience creating AI-enabled applications, agentic workflows, or intelligent automation using platforms and frameworks such as Claude, Azure OpenAI, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, LangChain, or similar technologies.
* Experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins.
